project_title: GlowSalon SaaS - Multi-tenant Beauty Salon Management & AI WhatsApp Booking Platform

theme_strategy.rationale: Beauty, spa, and salon platforms thrive on warm, clean, organic aesthetics with high contrast, natural tones, and crisp status markers for agenda scanning.

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Warm Editorial High-End: Playfair Display for decorative titles/badges, Plus Jakarta Sans for structural headings & subheadings, DM Sans for crisp UI text & form fields.

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.padding_system: Generous spacing philosophy: p-6 to p-12 for dashboard cards and panels to avoid cramming
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: High Density Grid Mode B for multi-tenant analytics & Tetris Grid Mode A for public salon portal (/b/slug)
layout_and_spacing.calendar_grid_layout: Multi-column timeline sticky header per stylist, 15/30-minute incremental slots, color-coded by service category
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Top fixed blur header for public portal (z-50) & left collapsible vertical sidebar for tenant/superadmin dashboards

component_guidelines.shadcn_js_usage: Always import from @/components/ui/ (e.g., button.jsx, dialog.jsx, dropdown-menu.jsx, tabs.jsx, calendar.jsx, sheet.jsx, select.jsx). Note files are .jsx or .js in this workspace.

custom_components.whatsapp_simulator: Floating/Embedded WhatsApp Chat Drawer mimicking official iOS/Android WhatsApp interface with AI Claude Sonnet 4.5 assistant badge, interactive quick-replies, automated reminder templates, and appointment confirmation preview.
custom_components.public_booking_portal: Public URL view (/b/:slug) with customizable hero image, service menu accordion, stylist selector cards, date/time picker, cross-selling/upselling add-on suggestions before checkout, and instant WhatsApp confirmation preview.
custom_components.super_admin_panel: Platform-wide MRR/ARR charts, active tenants table, module toggle matrix (CRM, Loyalty, Waiting List, AI Bot, Multi-branch), plan management, and billing status with delinquency warning/suspension controls.
custom_components.smart_calendar_agenda: Interactive day/week/month view by branch & stylist with drag-and-drop time slots, quick booking popover, waitlist match alerts, and conflict notifications.
custom_components.loyalty_and_upsell_engine: Points calculator card, discount coupon generator, and automated AI rule suggestions (e.g. 'Sugerir Tratamiento Capilar Reparador al reservar Balayage (+25.00€)').

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, links, inputs, metrics, tables, and modals MUST specify kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="superadmin-tenant-row-1-toggle", data-testid="booking-submit-button", data-testid="whatsapp-sim-send-btn").
testing_and_accessibility.aria_labels: Ensure screen reader accessibility for calendar navigation, WhatsApp chat messages, and module toggle switches.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure UI is completely in Spanish (ES).
Support clear multi-tenant switching (Super Admin view vs Tenant Company view vs Branch view vs Public Booking Portal /b/slug).
Ensure the WhatsApp simulator feels like a realistic chat drawer with AI Sonnet 4.5 responses for automated booking and reminders.
Implement clear role-based access visual cues (Super Admin, Admin Empresa, Gerente Sucursal, Recepcionista, Estilista).
Add testid attributes to every actionable item.
